identityReview: Compared named institutional/award biographies with independent reporting and the source-captioned photograph.
lifeStatusEvidence: Recent 2026 institutional or news material checked for the person’s public activity; access on 2026-11-15 is distinct from the 2026-11-13 factual cutoff.

lifeStatusReview.note: Selected source material was checked, not continuous life-status monitoring.

sourceReview.scope: Direct browsing/search and downloaded source-page review; cached structured evidence was treated as leads. Wikipedia supplied supplementary chronology, cross-checked against named institutions and reporting.
sourceReview.limits: Some institutional/news pages rate-limited, blocked direct HTTP, or supplied only search-extracted text. This is a selective AI editorial review; source format does not independently certify facts. Claims and allegations are attributed, and scheduled events are not treated as completed.
sourceReview.accessNotes: WHO biography/governance/reelection pages retrieved; Reuters/VOA reelection article opened separately. A TIME lead returned unrelated newsletter content and was excluded.
